Nunchuk review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: A non-custodial bitcoin inheritance platform: Nunchuk holds one key it can't use alone, and a timelock unlocks funds for your beneficiary on the date you set. Best for: Bitcoin holders who want timelock-based inheritance without KYC.

Good

Best for

Bitcoin holders who want timelock-based inheritance without KYC.

Skip if

you want a fully free inheritance plan

Pros

  • On-chain or off-chain timelock
  • Beneficiary can claim without Nunchuk's involvement
  • No KYC required

Cons

  • Inheritance needs a paid plan
  • Bitcoin only
  • Setup is more technical than a custodial service

Frequently asked questions

Is Nunchuk good for digital legacy planning?

A non-custodial bitcoin inheritance platform: Nunchuk holds one key it can't use alone, and a timelock unlocks funds for your beneficiary on the date you set.

Who is Nunchuk best for?

Bitcoin holders who want timelock-based inheritance without KYC.

How much does Nunchuk cost?

Free DIY wallets; the inheritance plan (Honey Badger) is listed at 480/year. Check current pricing and currency.

What are the downsides of Nunchuk?

Inheritance needs a paid plan; Bitcoin only; Setup is more technical than a custodial service.

What are alternatives to Nunchuk?

Alternatives in the same category include Casa, Unchained, Vault12 Guard.
